title: Electric force at M
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the magnitude of the net electric force on S1 at point M as √2 kQ²/(4L²).

title: Momentum magnitude of S2
description: Essential: Correctly determines the magnitude of S2's momentum before the collision as 8kQ²√(gL)/(9gL²).

title: Initial kinetic energy condition
description: Essential: Correctly states the inequality for the initial kinetic energy: Ek > (13-8√2)kQ²/(27L).

title: Mass derivation from graph
description: Important: Uses the acceleration graph (point C) and force analysis to correctly derive the mass of S1 as 8kQ²/(27gL²).

title: Collision analysis
description: Important: Applies conservation of momentum and the given kinetic energy condition for S1 to solve for S2's velocity/momentum.

title: Condition for reaching N
description: Important: Identifies that reaching point N requires the velocity at the equilibrium point D (where a=0) to be greater than zero.

title: Work-energy application
description: Important: Correctly applies the work-energy theorem between points M and D, incorporating gravitational and electric potential energy changes.

title: Sign error in momentum
description: Pitfall: Uses the incorrect sign for S2's momentum (e.g., positive instead of negative for motion along -x axis) without taking the magnitude.

title: Force vector addition error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly adds the Coulomb forces from A and B at point M (e.g., scalar sum instead of vector sum, wrong angle).

title: Unit or constant omission
description: Optional: Includes correct units (e.g., N, kg m/s, J) or explicitly states the electrostatic constant k in final expressions.
